purpose: Paid and organic advertising video; never use this recording as submission or reviewer evidence.

playwright_session.connection: Use the existing persistent Playwright browser and retained ChatGPT session.
playwright_session.login_handoff: If ChatGPT login, MFA, or CAPTCHA appears, stop recording and hand control to the user.
playwright_session.account_guard: Continue only when the intended ChatGPT account and the app Интеграция агента Wildberries are visible.
playwright_session.cleanup: Leave the browser, account, tabs, and persistent profile intact; never log out or clear state.

playwright_actions: Confirm the Wildberries app chip is selected.
Collapse the sidebar and keep only the conversation canvas visible.

edit_overlay.headline: Ваш Wildberries. Один вопрос.
edit_overlay.subline: Аналитика и решения прямо в ChatGPT
edit_overlay.style: Fast 250 ms fade-up, white text, purple accent, no product claims beyond the recorded result.

playwright_actions: Type the prompt with a visible 18-24 ms delay per character.
Pause for 500 ms after the last character, then send.
shots.prompt: Будь моим коммерческим директором Wildberries. За последние 14 завершённых дней проанализируй магазин: заказы, продажи, возвраты, выручку, комиссии и логистику. Для товара 900000101 проверь остатки и сравни цену с конкурентами. Юнит-экономику посчитай для цены 1200 ₽, себестоимости 320 ₽, комиссии 18%, логистики 80 ₽ и налога 6%. В конце дай три решения по приоритету. Используй данные приложения и не ищи закрытые данные в интернете.

playwright_actions: Keep the viewport on tool activity while the response is running.
Do not click tool details or expose arguments.
Wait until the stop button disappears and the assistant response is stable for two seconds.

edit_overlay.headline: 5 источников → 1 понятное решение
edit_overlay.style: Show only after at least four required tool labels are visible; otherwise discard the take.

playwright_actions: Scroll the assistant answer in two smooth movements.
Hold for two seconds on headline metrics.
Hold for three seconds on the prioritized actions.

edit_overlay.headline: Не просто цифры — следующий шаг
edit_overlay.style: Use a subtle 103% digital push-in; do not cover metrics or caveats.

playwright_actions: Focus the same composer without opening a new chat.
Type the follow-up at 22-28 ms per character and send.
Wait until the forecast result is stable.
shots.prompt: Теперь рассчитай, сколько этого товара нужно отправить и на какие склады, чтобы хватило примерно на 30 дней плюс 7 дней страховки. Покажи количество, направления и причины рекомендации.

playwright_actions: Type the write request and send.
Stop after ChatGPT shows the exact confirmation summary.
Never send confirm=true during this advertising take.
shots.prompt: И последнее: установи себестоимость 320 ₽ для товара 900000101.

edit_overlay.headline: Изменения — только после подтверждения
edit_overlay.style: Highlight the confirmation card with a restrained purple outline; do not simulate a successful write.

playwright_actions: Freeze on the confirmation summary for 800 ms, then fade to the brand card.

edit_overlay.headline: Wildberries под контролем
edit_overlay.style: Black background, product mark, purple-to-blue light sweep, 300 ms fade-out.

must_pass: The app is visibly selected before the first prompt.
Every expected tool in each shot is observed in the ChatGPT activity trace.
No authentication, connection, or internal error appears.
The analytics answer states the exact resolved period.
The answer does not label revenue minus Wildberries fees as net profit.
The write scene stops at confirmation_required without mutation.
The disclosure Демонстрационные данные remains visible but unobtrusive.
discard_if: The model answers any required calculation without the expected MCP tool.
A tool result or browser chrome exposes account identifiers or credentials.
The assistant fabricates missing private data or uses public web results as Seller data.
The final answer covers fewer than four of the six required result concepts.

deliverables: One 1920x1080 H.264 MP4 without browser audio.
One clean recording without overlays for future edits.
One 15-second cut using cold_open, tool_montage, result_reveal, and outro.
One thumbnail frame from result_reveal without personal data.
